description.name: 2FA Email Verification
description.tagline: Email based two-factor authentication (2FA) for client logins.
description.long: 2FA Email Verification adds email based two-factor authentication to WHMCS client logins. After a successful password login a one time verification code is emailed to the client through your existing WHMCS mail configuration, and every client area page stays locked until the code is entered. Features per-client and per-group control, configurable code length and expiry, attempt and resend limits, a per-IP brute-force throttle, and a full verification log.
